Keep HTTP translation thin and predictable

API diagnostics preserve controllers as protocol exposures: one business dependency, one model contract and conventional HTTP language. That keeps routing and serialization at the edge while validation, policy and workflow remain reusable beneath it.

The value of enforcing this family

Consumers receive consistent endpoints and developers can add another exposure without duplicating business behaviour.

Choose a diagnostic below for its Standard references, architectural rationale and practical bad and good code examples.
